t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ei Allah lem, mam’too jee naige tarée, I ya ram kam geri lem mba kam mosso kul noin’g lem. Mayan missi noin’g basiné, ma m’to nje rem I too jé singa mon’g, ma m’to njé ndoo I too njé né kinga. Allah I ya ge kari ba, I ya too jé la ge dojé lo g toobel g I ya too deou doroi.
